base_items.name: Zucchini, weighed before spiralizing
base_items.note: USDA-style estimate: zucchini is high water; final cooked yield drops as liquid releases.

base_items.name: Baby bella / cremini mushrooms
base_items.note: White mushrooms also work; macros similar enough for review.

base_items.name: Minced garlic + dry seasonings
base_items.note: Garlic, garlic powder, smoked paprika, black pepper; estimate only.

base_items.name: Classico marinara
base_items.note: Typical jarred marinara estimate; exact label may vary.

base_items.name: Low-cal Classico alfredo
base_items.note: Light/low-cal alfredo estimate; exact label may vary.

base_items.name: Plain Greek yogurt
base_items.note: Assumes plain nonfat Greek yogurt. If using 2% or whole milk yogurt, fat/calories go up.

base_items.name: Xanthan gum
base_items.note: Mainly fiber; too much can make sauce gummy.

protein_options.name: 93% lean ground beef
protein_options.note: Assumes listed 225g is cooked/edible amount for review consistency; raw-label values may differ.

protein_options.name: Chicken breast
protein_options.note: Assumes cooked boneless skinless chicken breast.

protein_options.name: Sirloin steak
protein_options.note: Assumes cooked lean sirloin; doneness and trimming change fat.

protein_options.name: Chicken breast + sirloin steak
protein_options.note: Assumes cooked weights: 150g chicken breast plus 150g cooked sirloin.

steps.name: Spiralize the zucchini
steps.note: Weigh, trim, spiralize, and bag zucchini ends.

steps.name: Air-fry the mushrooms
steps.note: Load mushrooms; shake once if practical.

steps.name: Build the uncooked zucchini base
steps.note: Combine zucchini, mushrooms, garlic, and seasonings before heat.

steps.name: Cook your chosen protein
steps.note: Timing depends on protein and method; cook fully and set aside.

steps.name: Cook zucchini and pull liquid
steps.note: Cook until softened and watery but not mush; reserve liquid.

steps.name: Blend the creamy sauce
steps.note: Blend marinara, alfredo, yogurt, miso, sriracha, powders, and reserved liquid.

steps.name: Thicken carefully with xanthan gum
steps.note: Blend in tiny pinch slowly; stop before gummy.

steps.name: Combine and gently simmer
steps.note: Add protein and sauce; keep low to avoid yogurt curdling.

steps.name: Portion and store
steps.note: Let settle, then pack as one large batch or 4–6 servings.
